signals.thesis: Marathon Petroleum hit a fresh 52-week high as WTI crude spiked +6% on renewed US-Iran tensions. Refining margins widen when oil moves sharply — MPC is the purest US refining play with top-tier crack spread exposure. Forward PE 11.7x with 1.5% yield. The geopolitical oil premium is unlikely to reverse within our 10-day horizon.

Valero cleared its 52-week high with +6.3% on Iran oil spike, mirroring MPC's move. VLO runs the largest US refining capacity and owns the renewable diesel pivot (DGD JV). Two energy names in the top 10 is deliberate when oil jumps 6% in a session — this is the macro thesis of the week. Forward PE 12.9x, 1.8% yield.

Cardinal Health trades within 2.5% of its 52-week high at $243.21. Drug distribution is a non-cyclical cash machine — CAH benefits from GLP-1 distribution volumes (Ozempic/Mounjaro) without bearing pharma R&D risk. Forward PE 19.8x is reasonable for the predictable revenue growth. Healthcare is the defensive offset to our energy-heavy allocation.
